CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass CausalRole(str, Enum):\n    CAUSA_DIRECTA = \"CAUSA_DIRECTA\"\n    INDICADOR = \"INDICADOR\"\n    COMBINACION = \"COMBINACION\"\n    NULO = \"NULO\"\n\nclass ============================================================\n# QPU — objeto central (estado fisico + senales publicas)\n# ============================================================\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    # actuacion aplicada sobre el QPU\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\n    def public_signals(self) -> dict:\n        return {\n            \"t1\": dict(self.t1), \"t2\": dict(self.t2),\n            \"readout\": dict(self.readout), \"detuning\": dict(self.detuning),\n            \"gate2q\": dict(self.gate2q),\n        }\n\ndef make_qpu(n: int, cycle: int, drift_qubits: List[int], coupling=None) -> QPUState:\n    t2, t1, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n):\n        if q in drift_qubits:\n            t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 4.5 * cycle)\n        else:\n            t2[q] = 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.01 + (0.03 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 30.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -22.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.01 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 20.0)\n    cmap = coupling or [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return QPUState(n, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q, cmap)\n\nprint(\"QPU OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.265604Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.266098Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.284118Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.266066Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.282914Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QPU satelite (leen QPU / escriben actuacion en QPU)\n# ============================================================\nclass DSPProfiler:\n    def fit(self, samples):\n        x = np.asarray(samples, float)\n        if x.size < 2: return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n        c, b = float(np.std(x)), float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(x))))\n        g = float(np.max(x) - np.min(x))\n        return [c, b, g, float(1.0/(1.0+c+b))]\n\nclass AOMMembrane:\n    def __init__(self, capacity=12):\n        self.capacity, self.buf, self.state = capacity, [], Regime.ESTABLE\n    def update(self, friction):\n        self.buf.append(float(friction))\n        if len(self.buf) > self.capacity: self.buf.pop(0)\n        sm = float(np.mean(self.buf))\n        if self.state == Regime.ESTABLE:\n            if sm >= 0.55: self.state = Regime.INESTABLE\n            if sm >= 0.72: self.state = Regime.CONFLICTO\n        elif self.state == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            if sm >= 0.72: self.state = Regime.CONFLICTO\n            elif sm < 0.35: self.state = Regime.ESTABLE\n        else:\n            if sm < 0.58: self.state = Regime.INESTABLE\n        return self.state, sm\n\nclass Ojos:\n    \"\"\"Lee solo senales publicas del QPU.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, hist_n=12, seed=0):\n        self.dsp, self.aom = DSPProfiler(), AOMMembrane(hist_n)\n        self._hist = []\n        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    def observe(self, qpu: QPUState) -> dict:\n        health, frics = {}, []\n        for q in range(qpu.n):\n            f = 0.0\n            f += max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t2[q]/150.0)*0.35\n            f += max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t1[q]/100.0)*0.15\n            f += min(1.0, qpu.readout[q]/0.05)*0.25\n            f += min(1.0, abs(qpu.detuning[q])/30.0)*0.10\n            f += min(1.0, qpu.gate2q[q]/0.02)*0.15\n            f = float(np.clip(f, 0, 1))\n            health[q] = float(np.clip(1-f, 0, 1)); frics.append(f)\n        friction = float(np.mean(frics))\n        self._hist.append(friction)\n        if len(self._hist) > 32: self._hist.pop(0)\n        firma = self.dsp.fit(self._hist)\n        self.aom.capacity = max(4, int(8 + 8*firma[3]))\n        regime, smoothed = self.aom.update(friction)\n        cands = sorted(health, key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        return {\"friction\": friction, \"smoothed\": smoothed, \"regime\": regime,\n                \"firma_dsp\": firma, \"health\": health, \"candidates\": cands}\n\nclass Reflejos:\n    \"\"\"MORPH sobre coupling_map del QPU + health de Ojos.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, n_logical): self.n = n_logical\n    def select(self, qpu: QPUState, eyes: dict) -> dict:\n        ranked = list(eyes[\"candidates\"])\n        edges = {(min(a,b), max(a,b)) for a,b in qpu.coupling_map}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden: avoided += 1; continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a,b in edges:\n                if a==q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b==q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n: break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n: break\n            if q not in selected: selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[:self.n]\n        score = float(np.mean([eyes[\"health\"].get(q,0) for q in selected])) if selected else 0.0\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided}\n\nclass Juicio:\n    def __init__(self, thr=0.92): self.thr = thr\n    def decide(self, eyes: dict, morph: dict) -> dict:\n        do_a = max(0.0, self.thr - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.5\n        do_z = eyes[\"friction\"] * 0.8\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO: do_z += 0.25\n        elif eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.INESTABLE: do_z += 0.12\n        c, z = abs(do_a) >= 0.20, abs(do_z) >= 0.20\n        if c and z: role = CausalRole.COMBINACION\n        elif c: role = CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA\n        elif z: role = CausalRole.INDICADOR\n        else: role = CausalRole.NULO\n        if eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= self.thr:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.HOLD, \"estable_hold\", 0.0\n        elif role == CausalRole.INDICADOR or eyes[\"regime\"] == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"latent_dd\", float(do_z)\n        elif do_a >= do_z:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.REMAP, \"candidate_remap\", float(do_a)\n        else:\n            inter, reason, gain = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"combined_dd\", float(do_z)\n        return {\"role\": role, \"intervention\": inter, \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n                \"expected_gain\": gain, \"reason\": reason, \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z}\n\nclass Manos:\n    \"\"\"Escribe DD + fase + layout sobre el QPU (Centinela).\"\"\"\n    def act(self, qpu: QPUState, judgment: dict) -> dict:\n        dd = judgment[\"intervention\"] in (Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, Intervention.DD_ALWAYS)\n        seq = \"CPMG\" if dd else \"NONE\"\n        tg = judgment[\"targets\"]\n        phase = 0.0\n        if tg:\n            phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in tg])) * 1e-3\n        qpu.layout = list(tg)\n        qpu.dd_on = dd\n        qpu.dd_seq = seq\n        qpu.phase_vz = phase\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase,\n                \"probe_state\": \"degraded\" if dd else \"stable\", \"layout\": list(tg)}\n\nprint(\"modulos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.285923Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.286349Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.318564Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.286289Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.317732Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"modulos + OBSERVABLE — mismos inputs de ruido para base y EQG\n# ============================================================\ndef physical_friction(qpu: QPUState, layout: Optional[List[int]] = None) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Friccion fisica del layout usado (misma formula para ambos hilos).\"\"\"\n    qs = layout if layout else list(range(qpu.n))\n    frics = []\n    for q in qs:\n        f = max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t2[q]/150.0)*0.35\n        f += max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t1[q]/100.0)*0.15\n        f += min(1.0, qpu.readout[q]/0.05)*0.25\n        f += min(1.0, abs(qpu.detuning[q])/30.0)*0.10\n        f += min(1.0, qpu.gate2q[q]/0.02)*0.15\n        frics.append(float(np.clip(f, 0, 1)))\n    return float(np.mean(frics))\n\ndef run_workload(qpu: QPUState, h_ideal: float, use_eqg_actuation: bool) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"\n    WorkloadChannel: ejecuta sobre el estado actual del QPU.\n    Si use_eqg_actuation: aplica layout MORPH + mitigacion DD/fase de Manos.\n    Si no: layout ingenuo [0..n-1], sin DD.\n    \"\"\"\n    if use_eqg_actuation and qpu.layout:\n        layout = list(qpu.layout)\n        dd = qpu.dd_on\n        phase = abs(qpu.phase_vz)\n    else:\n        layout = list(range(qpu.n))\n        dd = False\n        phase = 0.0\n\n    fr = physical_friction(qpu, layout)\n    # mitigacion fisica atribuible a Manos (Centinela):\n    # DD reduce dephasing efectivo; VZ reduce error de fase residual\n    mit = 1.0\n    if dd:\n        mit *= 0.62          # ~ alineado a ~35-40% excess dephasing removed (orden informe)\n    if phase > 0:\n        mit *= max(0.85, 1.0 - min(0.1, phase))  # correccion de fase barata\n\n    h_real = h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, fr * mit))\n    his = HIS(h_ideal, h_real)\n    return {\n        \"layout\": layout, \"dd\": dd, \"friction_phys\": fr, \"mitigation\": mit,\n        \"H_ideal\": h_ideal, \"H_real\": h_real, \"HIS\": his,\n    }\n\nprint(\"workload OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.319635Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.320008Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.347452Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.319975Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:14:18.346239Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"workload QPU-centrico: un QPU por ciclo, dos workloads\n# ============================================================\nCONFIG = {\n    \"n\": 8,\n    \"n_cycles\": 30,\n    \"h_ideal\": 1.5,\n    \"his_floor\": 0.15,\n    \"drift_qubits\": [1, 3, 5, 6],\n}\n\nojos = Ojos(seed=7)\nreflejos = Reflejos(CONFIG[\"n\"])\njuicio = Juicio(thr=0.92)\nmanos = Manos()\n\nhist = []\nbreak_base = break_eqg = None\n\nfor c in range(CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]):\n    qpu = make_qpu(CONFIG[\"n\"], c, CONFIG[\"drift_qubits\"])\n\n    # --- satelites leen QPU ---\n    eyes = ojos.observe(qpu)\n    morph = reflejos.select(qpu, eyes)\n    plan = juicio.decide(eyes, morph)\n    hands = manos.act(qpu, plan)   # escribe en qpu\n\n    # --- dos ejecuciones del mismo QPU fisico ---\n    # baseline: ignora \"judgment\": {**plan, \"role\": plan[\"role\"].value, \"intervention\": plan[\"intervention\"].value},\n        \"hands\": hands,\n        \"workload_base\": wl_base,\n        \"workload_eqg\": wl_eqg,\n    }\n    hist.append(row)\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - 1:\n        print(\"c=%02d  HIS_base=%.3f  HIS_eqg=%.3f  mit=%.2f  regime=%s  %s  dd=%s\" % (\n            c, wl_base[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"mitigation\"],\n            eyes[\"regime\"].value, plan[\"intervention\"].value, hands[\"dd_applied\"]))\n\nextra = None\nif break_base is not None:\n    extra = (break_eqg - break_base) if break_eqg is not None else CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - break_base\nprint(\"\\nbreak_base=%s  break_eqg=%s  extra=%s\" % (break_base, break_eqg, extra))\nprint(\"mean HIS decide minima accion (do A / do Z).\n5. **Manos** escribe en el QPU (Centinela).\n6. **Workload** se ejecuta dos veces sobre el **mismo** estado fisico: con y sin actuacion.\n7. **Observable** reporta
